policy: Real photographs only. Every image is an unmodified (colour-corrected only) photograph by a named photographer, sourced from Wikimedia Commons at a licence that permits reuse. No AI-generated or synthetic imagery is used anywhere in this atlas. Library photographs are documentary context images and are always labelled as such; they are never presented as a photograph of a specific dish.
